name: [[480,16,26]] weight-6 two-block group algebra code over C12 x Dic5
solver: anchored exhaustive search with exclusions, two independent implementations (exactA.c, exactB.c; github.com/TimoKellerMath/quantum-error-correction @ aaa18674c9a1, two-block-and-amplified-codes/src)
encoding: cluster growth through unsatisfied X-checks with exclusions, unit propagation, majority rule over the Z-checks and sums of two overlapping Z-checks (Z side; the X side with X and Z exchanged); anchors: one per orbit of a Tanner-graph automorphism group of order 240 (two orbits), earlier orbits excluded, and in a second set of runs pattern classes of the single check orbit (exactA) and the orbits in the other order (exactB); search through W = d - 2, parity of ker H_X and of ker H_Z

X.note: no nontrivial X-logical operator of weight <= 24; every element of ker H_Z has even weight (all column weights 3), so d_X >= 26. First runs (W = 25, searched 24; one anchor per orbit, earlier orbits excluded): exactA 105374138 nodes, 366 s; exactB 108721700 nodes, 402 s. Second runs on a relabelled instance with an independently computed group (W = 24): exactA with pattern classes, 28171810 nodes, 47 s; exactB with the orbits in the other order, 119022416 nodes, 261 s

Z.note: no nontrivial Z-logical operator of weight <= 24; every element of ker H_X has even weight (all column weights 3), so d_Z >= 26. First runs (W = 25, searched 24; one anchor per orbit, earlier orbits excluded): exactA 106226591 nodes, 314 s; exactB 110404866 nodes, 349 s. Second runs on a relabelled instance with an independently computed group (W = 24): exactA with pattern classes, 30042832 nodes, 50 s; exactB with the orbits in the other order, 122361101 nodes, 269 s

verification.note: two independently written exhaustive searches find no nontrivial X- or Z-logical operator of weight <= 24, and every logical has even weight, so d = 26 with the witnesses; completeness: exactA_NOTES.md, exactB_NOTES.md (with Proposition 3.1 and Corollary 3.2 of weight6-exact-distances/exact_distances.pdf) in two-block-and-amplified-codes/src at github.com/TimoKellerMath/quantum-error-correction @ aaa18674c9a1, where make long reruns the searches; no replayable proof object
